Privacy Policy

Effective Date: November 16, 2026 · Operated by TruthOfMarket (Educational Market Data & Quantitative Research Desk)

1. Minimal Data Collection Principle

TruthOfMarket is architected with privacy-by-design. Visitors can run our US 401(k)/IRA retirement cashflow calculator and read our $0 starter manual without creating a password or sharing brokerage account credentials.

  • Passwordless Club & Launch Alert Opt-In: If you voluntarily join the Morning Bell Club, request a PDF guide by email, or reserve a VIP Founding Member discount, we store only your email address, optional nickname, and chosen interest topic to send requested educational emails. Every email includes a 1-click Unsubscribe link.
  • Payment Processing (Lemon Squeezy Store #296100): Credit card and billing details are processed exclusively by our Merchant of Record, Lemon Squeezy, LLC, on PCI-DSS Level 1 infrastructure. TruthOfMarket never receives or stores raw credit card numbers.
  • Browser Local Storage: UI preferences (dark/daylight theme, large-print font toggle, simulated calculator inputs, and license key state) are stored locally in your own browser's localStorage.

2. Zero Data Selling & Third-Party Sharing

We never sell, rent, or trade your email address or personal data to third-party data brokers or advertisers.

3. Anonymous Aggregate Telemetry

We record anonymous, cookie-free aggregate pageview and feature interaction counters solely to maintain uptime and improve software usability. No cross-site behavioral ad profiling is used.

4. Your Deletion & Access Rights (GDPR / CCPA)

You may unsubscribe in 1 click from any email footer or request immediate deletion or export of your email record at any time by emailing beable9489@gmail.com. Deletion requests are honored within 48 hours.
